svg.aria-label: cross-agent-skills: Skills any agent can run, not just Claude. Codex, Cursor, Gemini or an MCP client, with reliable handoffs between them. Steps: Read, what a non-Claude agent skips; Fix, the tool a skill assumes; Hand off, a label and a PR, not chat; Check, the other agent can run it. Output: a skill that works on any agent, and a clean handoff protocol.
